clips.title: The story
paras: East of the Great Forge, Thistlefuzz Arcanery draws enchanters and scholars. Gnome practitioners run this prominent workshop and academy, a haven for those who weave magic into metal and parchment. Its chambers hum with arcane energy beside the fires of dwarven industry.

East of the Great Forge, Thistlefuzz Arcanery contrasts with the clanging anvils of dwarven smiths. Across its two levels, scholars, practitioners, and apprentices gather to study enchanting and the arcane arts. Dwarves reshape steel with muscle and fire; the gnomes here show how raw arcane energy can be bound into weapons, armor, and curious tools. For spellcasters making their way through the mountain stronghold, the Arcanery remains an essential sanctuary.
